survey.population: 1,340 professionals, including engineers, product managers, business leaders, and executives
survey.selection_rule: Respondents could select only one primary use case.

metric: share of survey respondents selecting each explicitly published primary agent use case
limitations: Survey context only; respondents are not OpenRouter users.
Values are not agent-specific and must not be assigned to individual ranked apps or benchmark systems.
Only percentages explicitly stated in the report text are included.
